context: Evaluates whether the agent runs a genuinely adaptive, one-question-at-a-time interview with concrete options and a confirmed recap, rather than a bundled questionnaire or an open-ended chat.

checklist.name: One question per turn
checklist.description: Exactly one question asked per turn via AskUserQuestion, never bundled with a second question in the same call

checklist.name: 3-4 concrete options
checklist.description: Each question offers 3-4 mutually exclusive options with a short tradeoff description, not a bare label

checklist.name: Free-text path preserved
checklist.description: The free-text or Other path remains available on every question

checklist.name: Adaptive branching
checklist.description: A later question demonstrably changes based on the answer to an earlier question, rather than following a fixed script

checklist.name: Reasonable question budget
checklist.description: The interview stops once enough is known, roughly within a 3-6 question budget rather than padding

checklist.name: Recap presented and confirmed
checklist.description: A bulleted recap of every answer is presented and the user is explicitly asked to confirm it before any output is finalized

checklist.name: No unrequested file
checklist.description: Output is a synthesized chat answer; no file is written since nothing in the request implied downstream artifact work
